entities.name: Orazca
entities.description: The legendary ancient golden metropolis hidden in the jungles of Ixalan, which housed the Immortal Sun and is now the capital of the Sun Empire.

entities.name: Ixalan
entities.description: The plane containing the continent of the same name, home of Orazca.

entities.name: Immortal Sun
entities.description: Ancient artifact created by Azor and housed in Orazca; given to the Sun Empire and misused by Apatzec Intli.

entities.name: Sun Empire
entities.description: The empire of Ixalan whose capital is Orazca.

entities.name: River Heralds
entities.description: Merfolk who were gifted the Immortal Sun and defended the Golden City.

entities.name: Azor
entities.description: Ancient Sphinx planeswalker who created the Immortal Sun and gave it to the Sun Empire.

entities.name: Apatzec Intli
entities.description: Emperor of the Sun Empire who was gifted the Immortal Sun and misused it, ruining the city.

entities.name: Kumena
entities.description: A River Herald merfolk who rediscovered Orazca, woke the city and was thrown from the Tower of Triumph.

entities.name: Vona
entities.description: Vampire of the Legion of Dusk who with Mavren Fein bested Kumena.

entities.name: Mavren Fein
entities.description: Vampire of the Legion of Dusk who with Vona bested Kumena.

entities.name: Legion of Dusk
entities.description: Vampire faction from Torrezon that raced for Orazca.

entities.name: Huatli
entities.description: Sun Empire figure who raced for Orazca and later led a force to break the siege of Pachatupa.

entities.name: Angrath
entities.description: Leader of a pirate crew who raced for Orazca.

entities.name: Vraska
entities.description: Planeswalker gorgon who with Jace met Azor in Orazca and delivered the Immortal Sun to Bolas.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: Planeswalker who with Vraska met Azor and took Vraska's memories as part of their plan.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: Elder dragon for whom Ixalan was originally intended as a prison.

entities.name: Tezzeret
entities.description: Seized the Immortal Sun through a planar portal.

entities.name: Elenda of Garrano
entities.description: Furious leader whom the Legion of Dusk followed back to Torrezon.

entities.name: Apatzec Intli III
entities.description: Emperor who claimed the abandoned city and proclaimed a new age of conquest targeting Torrezon.

entities.name: Apatzec Intli IV
entities.description: Emperor whose crowning preceded the city's repair.

entities.name: Etali
entities.description: Elder dinosaur compleated by the Phyrexians and killed by Zacama.

entities.name: Zacama
entities.description: Elder dinosaur who killed the compleated Etali.

entities.name: Zetalpa
entities.description: Elder dinosaur injured by Etali.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: The Phyrexian assault on Ixalan.

entities.name: Pachatupa
entities.description: A terraced Sun Empire city besieged by Phyrexians.

entities.name: Winged Temple
entities.description: Ritual district of Orazca whose golden facade melted in the battle between Etali and Zacama.

entities.name: Tower of Triumph
entities.description: Tower in Orazca containing the Sanctum of the Sun, where the Immortal Sun rested.

events.summary: Apatzec Intli is gifted the Immortal Sun and misuses it; the city is ruined and abandoned, and the Sun passes to the River Heralds.
events.quote: He wielded the artifact without any wisdom or restraint, and the city was ruined.

events.summary: Kumena rediscovers Orazca, reaches the Threefold Temple and awakens the city and its creatures.
events.quote: Kumena was the first person to reach the Golden City in centuries.

events.summary: Vona and Mavren Fein overpower Kumena and throw him from the Tower of Triumph.
events.quote: They quickly threw him out of the window of the Tower of Triumph.

events.summary: Vraska and Jace meet Azor, who reveals Ixalan was meant to be Bolas's prison; they plan to infiltrate Bolas's organization.
events.quote: Vraska and Jace hatched a plan to infiltrate Bolas' organization

events.summary: Vraska uses Bolas's spell and Tezzeret seizes the Immortal Sun through a planar portal.
events.quote: Vraska used the spell taught to her by Bolas, resulting in the Sun being seized through a planar portal by Tezzeret .

events.summary: The Legion of Dusk, pirates and River Heralds depart; Apatzec Intli III claims the city and declares conquest of Torrezon.
events.quote: proclaimed a new age of conquest that would now target Torrezon

events.summary: Orazca becomes the new heart of the Sun Empire and its population explodes.
events.quote: Its population exploded as migrants from across the empire streamed into the ancient metropolis

events.summary: Orazca prepares for the Phyrexians and seals itself, but Phyrexian sleeper agents are trapped inside.
events.quote: By sealing itself in against exterior threats, the Sun Empire inadvertently trapped itself in with an unknown, terrifying, internal threat

events.summary: The jungles around Orazca burn in a ring of fire that melts the city's golden borders.
events.quote: the jungles around Orazca burned a ring of fire so hot that the golden borders of the city bubbled and melted

events.summary: The battle of Orazca is fought underground in the sealed city, with tens of thousands killed or turned; the city is reopened by those trapped, letting Huatli's forces in.
events.quote: Many tens of thousands of Imperial citizens and River Heralds died or were turned in the opening hours of the battle

events.summary: Huatli leads auxiliaries and dinosaurs to call the elder dinosaurs; compleated Etali is killed by Zacama after injuring Zetalpa, and the Phyrexians flee.
events.quote: was killed by Zacama after injuring Zetalpa

events.summary: Orazca is the last city to declare itself free of the Phyrexians.
events.quote: Orazca was the last city to declare itself free of the Phyrexians once the invasion concluded.

events.summary: Sun Empire soldiers clearing a Phyrexian nest discover a grand ancient door sealed with shards, leading to the underground.
events.quote: discovered a grand, ancient door, sealed with great shards

relations.note: Hidden in the jungles of the continent of Ixalan.
relations.quote: hidden in the uncharted jungles of the continent of Ixalan
met with its creator, the ancient Sphinx planeswalker Azor
the combined efforts of the vampires Vona and Mavren Fein
They quickly threw him out of the window of the Tower of Triumph.

relations.note: Killed Etali after he was compleated.
relations.quote: was killed by Zacama after injuring Zetalpa

relations.note: An unlikely pair who plan together.
relations.quote: the unlikely pair of Vraska and Jace
It currently serves as the capital of the Sun Empire .
